text:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — I'm going to push the model-catalog change that adds redwood/gptx-3b-v2 and pins the hosted default for 3b models to v2. Plan: merge at 2024-04-01 21:30 UTC, deploy to staging -> run smoke -> roll to prod at 22:00 if green. @Maya can you do smoke checks? @Jordan please have rollback ready. :rocket:

Maya Chen: Got it. I'll run the smoke suite and key perf checks (latency p95, cost per token) after staging deploy. ETA 21:35 UTC.

Jordan Lee: I'll prepare rollback patch and the canary traffic policy. If anything fails, we can revert the catalog entry and route to v1. I'll be watching from 21:25.

deploy-bot: Deployment job #dpl-20240401-78 started — applying catalog change to staging.

Samir Patel: Smoke checklist: 1) simple generation, 2) chat-flow with tool-calls, 3) embedding similarity sanity, 4) cost/perf quick metrics. Use this curl:

``
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-3b-v2","input":"Write a 2-sentence product update."}'
```

Maya Chen: Running generation now...

QA Bot: Smoke test suite started (tests: gen-basic, chat-flow, embedding-sanity, latency-check). Expected time ~3m.

Maya Chen: gen-basic passed. p95 latency ~140ms (staging GPUs). embedding-sanity passed. chat-flow had 1 failure (tool-call stub not returning expected structure) — investigating.

Samir Patel: Noted — @Maya what's the error? paste logs if possible.

Maya Chen: Error: tool call response missing 'tool_output' key. Happens only when sequence > 512. Re-running with truncated input.

Jordan Lee: That looks like a tokenization / truncation edge. I have a rollback ready but let's try a quick config tweak: set model param max_tokens to 256 for tool-call paths in staging rollout. I can patch the rollout config.

Priya Raman: From product side, we prefer not to roll back unless generation quality is bad. If tool-calls are reproducible, we should patch routing config temporarily.

Samir Patel: Agreed. Jordan, patch rollout to limit that code path for now. If we still see fail rate >1% within 20m, we roll back.

deploy-bot: Canary config updated: max_tokens=256 for tool_paths. Canary traffic: 10%.

Maya Chen: Re-running chat-flow — now passes on 9/10 canary runs. Latency stable. Embedding quality unchanged.

Samir Patel: Good. Keep monitoring for 20 minutes. Jordan, stand by for rollback; share the rollback command here.

Jordan Lee: Rollback command:

``
redwoodctl catalog set-default --model-type=generation --model=redwood/gptx-3b-v1 --reason "rollback: staging failure"
```

Jordan Lee: Also have terraform patch to revert catalog entry if needed (link: https://git.redwood/infra/changes/PR-452)

Maya Chen: 20m passed, canary at 10% with 0.2% failure. I'm green to promote to prod at 22:00 UTC.

Samir Patel: Proceeding with prod rollout at 22:00. I'll kick off merge in 10m.

deploy-bot: Prod deployment scheduled at 2024-04-01T22:00:00Z — job #dpl-20240401-79.

Priya Raman: Thanks all — please add a note to release notes about default pinning change and known tool-call truncation workaround.

Samir Patel: Will do. Tagging this thread in release notes doc. :white_check_mark:
